rules: Never rewrite or reinterpret a CommitV1 hash as CommitV2
Mixed-history projections may expose legacy provenance as unavailable but must not fabricate Statements or Decisions
Operation payloads compile into Effect.operations through the YOps adapter
Source spans compile into Proposal Claim evidence only when immutable resource bytes and locators are available
Provider output is untrusted application input, not a protocol object
Inferred, authored, stated, and unspecified Claim modes remain explicit during compilation
Draft status and review questions remain application projection state
Answering a question creates a Statement or a new Proposal when Effect, intent, or rationale changes
